svg.title: A strip plot of 826 poles in three columns. The median token_r2 is 0.86 for token-set, 0.40 for mixed, 0.31 for context.
svg.text: The token mean explains far more of a token-set pole's activity (AUROC 0.91)
Each VERIFIED pole's token_r2, the share of its activation variance that a mean per
token id explains on its scan corpus, by the label of its explanation. One dot per
pole; the ink line and value are each label's median. The AUROC's 95% interval
over a bootstrap of poles is 0.88–0.93.
